_about: Hand-maintained exceptions for beer_match.py (audit M6). A brewery key matches a shop's brewery text by WHOLE WORDS (letters folded), e.g. 'zichovec' matches 'Rodinny Pivovar Zichovec' but not 'Zichovecky'. Edit this file, run the tests, push - no code change needed.

knownTerms._about: In-house abbreviations and shop misspellings, replaced anywhere in a beer name (whole words, case-insensitive).
knownTerms.oninni: Our New IPA Needs No Introduction

breweryTerms._about: Terms that mean something else for one brewery. Checked before knownTerms.

overrideByNameTerm._about: A sub-line catalogued as its own brewery: brewery key -> {word in the beer name -> brewery to search under}.

breweryRename._about: The shop's brewery text is not a brewery on Untappd; search under this name instead (the original is still tried too).

breweryAliases._about: Extra brewery names worth trying after the shop's own, when a brewery is catalogued under several names.
